runs.note: The handoff's run order: ablation -> pilot labels -> supervised c2 -> matched PPO (A vs B).
PPO from rl-v1's best checkpoint (iteration 2,219) with rl-v2's helper inputs added at zero weight. The evaluation games are only measured, never trained on.

decisions.title: Branch B starts from s_z2_l100
decisions.text: Verified pairs at z 2 (305 train); anchors KL + value at weight 100, lr 1e-4, 100 epochs. Dev match vs c2 52.5% [49.3, 55.8] (best of 5 candidates on dev: flattered); bank: 7.2% of choices changed, mean gain +0.0008, harmful 1.2%, good 1.9%; anchor argmax agreement 97.0% (buys 94.6%). Weak anchors destroy c2 (lam 1, z 1: 21.7% vs c2), so anchoring is the key setting.
decisions.rejected: lam 0.3-30 (anchor drift 5-18%), z 1 labels (noisier), lam 300 (51.6%), 50 epochs (51.8%)

decisions.title: Pilot labels: buy-only
decisions.text: The simplest arm whose paired interval is above 50% (the handoff's rule). Ablation: mirror 50.0% [50.0, 50.0], buy 56.0% [53.0, 59.0], action 55.1% [52.4, 57.9], both 58.8% [55.6, 62.1]. Paired differences: buy - mirror +6.0 [+3.0, +9.0]; action - mirror +5.1 [+2.3, +7.8]; both - mirror +8.8 [+5.6, +12.1]; both - buy +2.8 [-1.2, +6.7]; both - action +3.8 [-0.4, +7.8]; action - buy -0.9 [-4.9, +3.2]
decisions.rejected: the other arms, as the first pilot

decisions.title: A separate trainer, sg-v1, with the trainers as submodules
decisions.text: The fixes go into rl-v3 and bv-v1 (their repos, with tests); sg-v1 only orchestrates, pinned to exact commits, so the rules and code it ran on are recorded.
decisions.rejected: running everything inside rl-v3 as new runs

decisions.title: Fix everything before a long run
decisions.text: All handoff fixes landed with tests first (PPO temperature, rejected records, seeds, frozen league entries, exclusions, step-zero checks; one teacher grader, action label-only mode, failure policy, validation draws, public sampler, cohorts, replay identity, match manifests).
decisions.rejected: starting the ablation on the old build

decisions.title: Fresh frozen manifests
decisions.text: Ablation 300, dev 300, matrix 500, promotion 2,000 kingdoms, none in another manifest or in BV-v1's streams; all 8,197 excluded from training and labelling.
decisions.rejected: reusing BV-v1's suite stream (already used for development)

decisions.title: Do not resume BV-v1's old suites and student
decisions.text: The matched ablation on one frozen build replaces the partly run action / combined suites; the student is not the student here (c2 is).
decisions.rejected: resuming suite_action (214/300) and the p1 student

decisions.title: Pilot labels by a predeclared rule
decisions.text: pipeline.py takes the simplest teacher arm whose paired interval is above 50% (buy, then action, then both), as the handoff says.
decisions.rejected: choosing after looking at the pilot

decisions.title: Prepare-once kept, though it saves no time
decisions.text: It gives identical grades and 6.6x fewer preparations; measured wall time unchanged, so the speed-up claim is withdrawn.

decisions.title: No game videos
decisions.text: The Play tab is off; the site shows results, curves and the log.
